title: Weekly 2026-09-20 — Soil sensor and pump controller
goal: Read soil moisture with an ESP32 and drive a separately supplied pump. Preserves a generated missing sensor connection as a demand-completeness failure.

rubric.must: The soil sensor output is visibly connected to an ESP32 input.
The pump, switching transistor, gate resistor and pull-down resistor are visible.
Controller, sensor and pump power labels are legible and distinct.

provenance.notes: Scenario selected from weekly demand. No customer IDs, contact details or source prompts are included. This is an evaluation input, not a certified correct example.
